anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: Thus then of a corresponding part, according as we are able, we partake of the true sheep, partaking of the Word of God.
pass_b_english: Thus then we partake of a [corresponding] part of the true sheep, as we are able, partaking of the Word of God.
source_text: Οὕτως οὖν [καταλλήλου] καθὸ δυνάμ[εθα μέρους μετα]λαμβάνομε[ν τοῦ προβάτου] τοῦ ἀληθινοῦ <μετα>λαμ[βάνοντες] τοῦ λόγου τοῦ θ(εο)ῦ.
